Using Hero's EMIS and TPP integrated online consultation platform, you can offer a full digital care navigation solution. Direct patients to relevant self-help, invite them to book with you or your PCN where appropriate, or request that they complete an online consultation. Customise the triage process with your preferred question set.
end of link, Watch a 2 minute demo
heading, How does Hero Health's online consultation tool work?, level 2

A triage alternative to eConsult or Accurx's Patient Triage. Use Hero's digital Care Navigation to assist patients in finding relevant services or invite them to submit online consultation enquiries. Create your own question sets for clinical and administrative triage.

Most triage solutions give you a standard online consultation output. But what if you want to ask more specific queries? Or if you want different information for adults than children? Or different information for ongoing matters compared to new issues? With Hero you can configure your triage question set to work for your practice.
end of listitem, level 1, position 1, set size 5

Instead of traditional triage solutions which generate vast quantities of inbound enquires, use Care Navigation to create pathways to relevant local services, self-help, direct booking or PCN appointments. Intercept and divert a percentage of patients to appropriate services before their request reaches your practice inbox.
end of listitem, level 1, position 2, set size 5

When online consultations do reach your Inbox within Hero, they are assigned to the appropriate team and then can be actioned. You can respond by SMS, Email or NHS app, or book patients directly into your diary or that of the hubsite. Use questionnaires to get more information if you require it.
end of listitem, level 1, position 3, set size 5

Why create workload for your administrative team if you know that certain patient enquiries will always require an appointment? With Hero's care navigation, you can create pathways that lead patients to book appointments directly into your clinical diary - for example for blood tests or NHS Health Checks.
end of listitem, level 1, position 4, set size 5

The problem with most triage solutions like Anima or eConsult is that they can't be easily configured to a practice's local setup. With Care Navigation, you can integrate popular tools you're already using - be that Joy for Social Prescribing, the NHS App for Prescriptions or Aide for Chronic Disease Management.
end of listitem, level 1, position 5, set size 5
